social_01.title: Say hello after meeting someone
social_01.briefing: Message Mila after you meet — say hi, remind her where you met and ask a question. Mila loves a chat, so one “hi” won’t cut it.

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

social_02.title: Reschedule a meeting
social_02.briefing: Your meeting with Zoe is at a bad time. Remind her of the plan, suggest a new slot and settle on the final one. Zoe won’t mind — just don’t leave her guessing.

objectiveLabels.objective_03: Say that the time does not work

zoe.styleNote: She chats lightly and sometimes uses a gentle joke to help you sound more natural.

social_03.title: Ask for directions
social_03.briefing: Ask Denis how to get where you’re going and which transport to take. Denis answers calmly and in detail — and if something’s unclear, just ask again.

denis.styleNote: He does not rush, reads details carefully, and replies without unnecessary noise.

social_04.title: Thank someone for help
social_04.briefing: Mila helped you out — tell her what exactly you’re thankful for and how it helped. She’ll enjoy the details more than a plain “thanks”.

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

social_05.title: Congratulate someone and ask a simple question
social_05.briefing: Zoe has something to celebrate. Congratulate her, add a short wish and ask about the occasion — she’ll happily tell you more.

zoe.styleNote: She chats lightly and sometimes uses a gentle joke to help you sound more natural.

social_06.title: Meet people in an interest chat
social_06.briefing: Denis and Mila are in a chat about a shared hobby. Introduce yourself, share your experience and ask about theirs — the chat keeps going while it’s interesting both ways.

denis.styleNote: He does not rush, reads details carefully, and replies without unnecessary noise.

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

social_07.title: Agree on a time and place
social_07.briefing: Arrange to meet Mila — offer two times, pick a place and decide how you’ll recognise each other. Mila’s up for any plan as long as it’s clear.

objectiveLabels.objective_05: Ask how to recognise each other

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

social_08.title: Invite someone to an event
social_08.briefing: Invite Zoe to an event — give the date and time and say why you want her there. If she hesitates, find a reason that makes it worth coming.

objectiveLabels.objective_04: Explain why you are inviting them

zoe.styleNote: She chats lightly and sometimes uses a gentle joke to help you sound more natural.

social_09.title: Cancel plans politely
social_09.briefing: You have to cancel plans with Denis and Mila. Apologise, briefly explain why and suggest another option — so it doesn’t sound like you don’t care.

denis.styleNote: He does not rush, reads details carefully, and replies without unnecessary noise.

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

social_10.title: Message after a meeting
social_10.briefing: Your meeting with Mila went well — drop her a message. Mention a specific moment, suggest doing it again and agree on when.

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

social_11.title: Bring a group plan together
social_11.briefing: Zoe and Denis are in a group chat, and everyone has different plans. Suggest an option, find out each person’s limits and get to a plan everyone confirms.

zoe.styleNote: She chats lightly and sometimes uses a gentle joke to help you sound more natural.

denis.styleNote: He does not rush, reads details carefully, and replies without unnecessary noise.

social_12.title: Support a friend
social_12.briefing: Denis is having a hard time. Ask if he wants to talk, listen without giving advice and offer specific help — but don’t push if he says no.

objectiveLabels.objective_02: Ask whether they want to talk
objectiveLabels.objective_06: Do not push after a refusal

denis.styleNote: He does not rush, reads details carefully, and replies without unnecessary noise.

social_13.title: Clear up a small misunderstanding
social_13.briefing: Mila and Zoe read your message differently than you meant it. Calmly sort out what was meant, own your part of the mix-up and bring back the friendly tone.

objectiveLabels.objective_04: Own your part of the confusion

mila.styleNote: She warmly keeps the conversation going and asks natural follow-up questions.

zoe.styleNote: She chats lightly and sometimes uses a gentle joke to help you sound more natural.

social_14.title: Decline tactfully
social_14.briefing: Zoe is inviting you, but you’ll have to say no. Thank her, decline clearly but warmly and offer something else — that keeps the door open for next time.

objectiveLabels.objective_02: Say the decision is not easy
objectiveLabels.objective_04: Give enough reason without excess detail

zoe.styleNote: She chats lightly and sometimes uses a gentle joke to help you sound more natural.

social_15.title: Discuss expectations
social_15.briefing: Everyone in the group expects something different, and Denis asks you to sort it out. Hear each view, find common ground, name the disagreement without blame and suggest a rule everyone accepts.

denis.styleNote: Practical and observant; he gets to the point without rushing people.

social_16.title: Give delicate feedback
social_16.briefing: Mila needs honest feedback, and it has to be said with care. Stick to facts, describe the impact, suggest one specific change and don’t forget her strengths.

objectiveLabels.objective_07: Agree how to check the result

mila.styleNote: Open and curious; she invites others in and responds thoughtfully to nuance.

social_17.title: Set a personal boundary
social_17.briefing: The same situation keeps happening, and it’s time to set a boundary. Tell Zoe and Denis what matters to you without blaming them — and offer an option that works for everyone.

zoe.styleNote: Expressive but considerate; she names what matters and leaves space for another view.

denis.styleNote: Practical and observant; he gets to the point without rushing people.

social_18.title: Rebuild trust
social_18.briefing: Because of your mistake, Denis no longer trusts you. Own it without excuses, apologise clearly, offer a real next step — then give him time to reply.

objectiveLabels.objective_05: Ask what would help repair it
objectiveLabels.objective_07: Accept they may not reply at once

denis.styleNote: Practical and observant; he gets to the point without rushing people.

social_19.title: Resolve a subtle group conflict
social_19.briefing: A quiet conflict is brewing between Mila and Zoe. Separate facts from assumptions, let each of them speak and shape a solution with no losers.

mila.styleNote: Open and curious; she invites others in and responds thoughtfully to nuance.

zoe.styleNote: Expressive but considerate; she names what matters and leaves space for another view.

work_01.title: Introduce yourself to a colleague
work_01.briefing: It’s your first day on the team — introduce yourself to Marina, say what you’re working on and ask a work question. Marina likes specifics, so get straight to the point.

work_03.briefing: Confirm the call with Sam — give the day, time and time zone, and don’t forget the link. Sam is relaxed, but without an exact time the call won’t happen.

work_04.title: Say you will be late
work_04.briefing: You’re running late for a meeting with Marina. Warn her right away, apologise, say when you’ll be there and ask whether to start without you. Marina will forgive lateness, not silence.

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

work_06.title: Clarify a simple task

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

work_07.title: Ask to move a deadline
work_07.briefing: You won’t make the deadline. Tell Marina early, explain where things stand and what’s in the way, give a realistic date and offer something in between.

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

work_08.title: Send a short status update
work_08.briefing: Oleg is waiting for a status update. Briefly say what’s done, what’s next and what’s blocking you, and ask for the help you need — Oleg appreciates keeping it short.

oleg.styleNote: Direct and organised; he values clarity, commitments, and realistic constraints.

work_09.title: Request access

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

work_10.title: Write after your first workday
work_10.briefing: Your first workday is done. Tell Marina what was useful, what you’ve already achieved and check tomorrow’s task — short and to the point, the way she likes it.

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

work_11.title: Agree on a team next step
work_11.briefing: The team discussion has dragged on. Sum it up, name what’s still open and agree with Oleg and Sam on the next step, an owner and a date.

oleg.styleNote: Direct and organised; he values clarity, commitments, and realistic constraints.

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

work_12.title: Explain a problem and propose a solution
work_12.briefing: A problem has come up at work. Explain to Sam what it is and what it affects, offer two solutions and help pick one — Sam stays calm but won’t let you drift off topic.

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

work_13.title: Collect availability for a meeting
work_13.briefing: You need to get Marina and Oleg into one meeting. Offer three slots, account for time zones, sort out the clash and send a confirmation.

objectiveLabels.objective_03: Ask for replies in one format

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

oleg.styleNote: Direct and organised; he values clarity, commitments, and realistic constraints.

work_14.title: Defend a realistic deadline
work_14.briefing: Oleg wants the result sooner than is realistic. Acknowledge the urgency, show the scope and the risks of rushing and suggest doing it in stages — a deadline that’s fair to everyone.

objectiveLabels.objective_04: Show risk in a rushed deadline

oleg.styleNote: Direct and organised; he values clarity, commitments, and realistic constraints.

work_15.title: Give a constructive review
work_15.briefing: Sam asked for feedback on his work. Start with a strength, go through one specific part, suggest an improvement and ask his view — feedback that helps rather than stings.

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

work_16.title: Agree on priorities with limited resources
work_16.briefing: There aren’t enough resources for everything. Go through the options with Marina and decide what matters most and what waits — she wants a clear order, not “we’ll do it all”.

marina.styleNote: Keeps a warm professional tone and brings a thread back to a concrete decision.

work_17.title: Disagree with a decision diplomatically
work_17.briefing: Oleg and Sam’s decision looks risky to you. Acknowledge its goal, make your case and propose an alternative — you can push back and still stay on the same side.

oleg.styleNote: Direct and organised; he values clarity, commitments, and realistic constraints.

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

work_18.title: Reduce a cross-team risk

sam.styleNote: Analytical and collaborative; he tests assumptions without losing the human context.

work_19.title: Run a complex negotiation in a thread

oleg.styleNote: Direct and organised; he values clarity, commitments, and realistic constraints.
